Question 16  
 
How many assignments make the following boolean expression 
result to true? 
A) 0 
 B)  2 
C)  4  
D)  6  
E)  7 
(A * B) ⊕ (C * D)
questions.explanation:
There is only 1 way to make one side of the xor true, and 3 ways to make one side of the 
xor false. (#true)*(#false) + (#false)*(#true) = (1)(3)+(3)(1) = 6
